title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E09 — Strangest Places
Explore an island ruled by deadly predators, a Florida town obsessed with the wildest circus performers, or a mysterious paranormal hotspot that's a magnet for UFOs, strange sightings, and baffling disappearances.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E15 — Unexpected Spectacles
Imagine a man floating through the sky by dozens of balloons or a circus only visible via magnifying glass; these are the tales of history's most unbelievable, strange and completely unexpected spectacles.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E18 — Most Astonishing Creatures
Some of Earth's most remarkable creatures push the limits of belief from a headless chicken who toured the nation, to a goat who tipped the scales of war, to dolphins drafted into Cold War espionage.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E19 — Maddest Minds
From a doctor who swallowed Yellow Fever vomit to prove a theory, to another who stitched together a two-headed dog, history's boldest experiments reveal just how far some minds will go.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:

title: The UnXplained
description:
S04 E01 — Mysterious Ancient Ruins
Some archeological finds are so baffling, they challenge what is known about the past; learning the truth about these mysterious ruins and answering the questions they continue to present.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S05 E10 — Holy Relics
Throughout history and across the globe, there have been many sacred relics believed to be imbued with mystical powers.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S01 E02 — Mysterious Structures
For centuries, archaeologists have tried to unravel the mysteries of how and why certain incredible structures like the Great Pyramid at Giza, the staircase at Loretto Chapel, and Coral Castle were built.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S01 E03 — Strange Creatures
Millions of people around the world claim to have had an encounter with a creature unlike any recognized by mainstream science such as the Mothman, Chupacabra, and Mongolian Death Worm.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S08 E13 — Unnerving Nature
Across the planet are places where nature behaves in ways that seem to defy explanation, forests where people vanish, deserts where signals fail, caves filled with toxic air and mountains no one dares to climb.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S04 E06 — Serial Killer Creatures
The animal kingdom is full of deadly predators, and some of them attack in extraordinary and inexplicable ways; some animals strike back at humans for reasons beyond normal defense and hunger.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S08 E10 — Mystery of the Dinosaurs
Dinosaurs have fascinated scientists for nearly two centuries, and in all that time, we have yet to answer even the most basic questions about how these animals lived, how they died, and what became of them.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S03 E05 — Secrets of the Immortals
Sacred waters with remarkable healing powers; ancient mystics who lived for hundreds of years; a scientific breakthrough may provide the answers to eternal life.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S01 E08 — Incredible Survivors
A look at how some people live through the impossible such as plane crashes, freezing temperatures, or performing superhuman feats while in danger; remarkable tales of human survival force others to reconsider what is known about the will to live.

title: The UnXplained
description:

title: The Mega-Brands That Built America
description:
S02 E06 — Clash of the Computer Titans
Steve Jobs starts a personal computer company in his parents' garage on his way to bringing computers mainstream; when he commissions the help of a software design company run by Bill Gates, it's the beginning of one of the biggest rivalries.

title: The Mega-Brands That Built America
description:
S02 E02 — Internet Killed the Video Store
A database software engineer is inspired to create a bigger, family-friendly video store, Blockbuster; an opening appears for two software executives in California to take on the media giant with their online subscription service, Netflix.

title: The Mega-Brands That Built America
description:
S01 E01 — Battle of the Superstores
Founding fathers of the biggest retail stores in the world battle to be the first to innovate, build, and revolutionize the industry; one of the top businessmen of the 20th century, Sam Walton, will construct the world's largest retail empire.

title: The Mega-Brands That Built America
description:
S01 E04 — Dirty Work
James Gamble and Harley Procter invent a revolutionary new soap that revolutionizes America and opens up a market to entrepreneurs in the late 1800s, when Americans rarely bathed and deadly diseases were commonplace.

title: The Mega-Brands That Built America
description:
S01 E03 — A Whole New Ballgame
The evolution of America's most beloved sports of baseball, basketball and football are made possible by the innovations of sporting goods pioneers named Spalding, Wilson, and the Rawlings brothers.

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description:
S02 E14 — Dangerous Dining
From chocolate eaten out of the gutter, to a single cup of ice cream shared by the entire neighborhood, to breakfast cereal that produced colorful consequences, yesterday's culinary delights weren't always as wholesome as they seemed.

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description:
S01 E05 — Treacherous Travel
Exploding cars and blimp disasters to kids sent through the mail and doomed personal helicopters; the past is packed with travel tales and the misfires that paved the road to modern transportation.

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description:
S02 E01 — Killer Crazes
"Everybody's doing it" was the reason enough to dive in; from flagpole sitting to pet skunks, revealing crazes sweeping the nation; these obsessions are impossible to resist; it's a trip to fads that push limits and make history must-see mayhem.

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description:
S01 E03 — Mad Medicine
There was a time when any and all cures could be sold to the public indiscriminately; diving into a world where animal skin can replace your own, where doctors give coffee enemas and a world of heroin-laced cough syrup.

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description:
S01 E08 — Occupational Hazards
Uncovering the downright dangerous gigs of the past, from mercury-poisoned hatmakers to kids crawling through chimneys and projectionists fleeing fiery blazes.

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description:
S01 E07 — Precarious Products
The everyday products that are way more dangerous than meets the unsuspecting eye; what were the most ill-advised and risky household products?

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description:
S02 E12 — Insane Inventions
These are the ambitious ideas, futuristic gadgets, and engineering marvels that aimed to revolutionize everyday life, but sometimes overshot the mark.

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description:
S01 E04 — Very Extreme Sports
The modern concept of extreme sports is a product of marketing, but back in the old days, the lack of rules made them truly extreme; from bone-crushing football and deadly baseball games to wild events like auto polo.

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description:
S02 E19 — Horrible Hygiene
Remember when the path to good hygiene was anything but clean?

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description:
S02 E20 — Surviving the '70s
Remembering growing up in the '70s, which meant embracing the risk as much as the fun -- from launching our bikes off homemade ramps and braving amusement park rides held together by only thrills and scarce safety regulations.

title: The Mega-Brands That Built America
description:
S04 E06 — Rise of the Personal Computer
A pair of garage tinkerers, a copier company's secret lab, and a college-dropout programmer spark a decades-long battle for the future of computing - shrinking the computer from a room-sized machine to the device billions carry every day.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S03 E04 — The Body on Somerton Beach
As the Cold War ramps up, a well-dressed man is found dead within miles of a nuclear testing site on a tranquil Australian beach; there are no clues to his identity or what could have happened.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S03 E07 — Malaysia Flight 370
One of the most chilling aviation mysteries in modern day: a Boeing 777, carrying 239 people, vanishes over the Indian Ocean; nearly a decade later, no one knows what really happened to Malaysia Flight 370.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E08 — Blackbeard's Lost Treasure
One of history's most notorious pirates, Blackbeard, is said to have had a treasure worth millions of dollars; after centuries of searching, the legendary hoard remains missing.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E09 — Decoding the Mysterious Antikythera Mechanism
An ancient mechanical device found on a 2000-year-old shipwreck has become known as the world's first computer; the machine is centuries more advanced than historians thought possible, but its origin and true purpose are shrouded in secrecy.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E14 — Who Is D.B. Cooper?
It's the only unsolved air piracy case in history; in 1971, a man hijacks a Northwest Orient Airlines flight, demanding four parachutes and $200,000; he jumps out of the plane with the money and is never seen again.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E17 — The Search for El Dorado
It is a legendary ancient city, said to be overflowing with gold; for centuries, explorers put their lives on the line searching for it; the quest to uncover this infamous city continues.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E21 — TWA Flight 800
In July 1996, one of the worst aviation disasters in American history leaves 230 people dead and countless questions unanswered; it's a tragedy that changes the aviation industry forever.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S05 E03 — The Lost Fortune of the Knights Templar
A look at what happened to the secret hoard of the Knights Templar, a treasure of gold, silver, gems and religious relics protected by a medieval religious order.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S05 E08 — The Mystery of Machu Picchu
With 500-year-old secrets hidden in skeletons and stone, Machu Picchu remains one of the most puzzling archaeological sites on earth; it ranks among the ancient world's most enduring riddles, pertaining to its creators and reason for its creation.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S05 E13 — The Legend of the Lost Dutchman's Mine
The search for the most famous gold mine in the Old West has led many to perish in the pursuit of its elusive riches.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E02 — The Franklin Expedition
The search for the illusive Northwest Passage leads to a historic expedition that sets sail into a labyrinth of ice and is never heard from again.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E04 — What is the Yeti?
Sightings of the Yeti, a creature of myth and legend, has been recorded for thousands of years throughout the Himalayas and surrounding regions; a seven-foot-tall creature, covered in shaggy gray hair is hiding in plain sight.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S07 E19 — The Hunt for the Anthrax Killer
Deadly anthrax spores sent through the mail kill five people and spread authorities thin; the FBI works around the clock to stop this brazen act of bioterrorism, but the letters keep coming.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S07 E20 — The Hunt for Osama bin Laden: Case Closed
On Sept. 11, 2001, an act of terror changes America; Mastermind Osama bin Laden threatens further attacks; a global manhunt begins; almost a decade later, U.S. Navy SEALs raid a compound in Abbottabad, Pakistan and kill him.

title: Hitler's DNA
description: At the end of WWII, an American colonel entered Hitler's bunker and cut a blood-soaked swatch from the couch where the tyrant shot himself. Eighty years later, this film follows a team as they extract DNA from the fabric.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
Shackleton's Endurance: The Lost Ice Ship Found
Following news of the history-making discovery of Sir Ernest Shackleton's ship the Endurance, this is a look at his historic and ill-fated 1914 Antarctic expedition resulting in the loss of the highly revered ship.
